statement: For the actual F12 common-involution curve, forgetting its ordinary point 1 gives an injective full profinite source map into the pure seven-point mapping class completion. The proof uses the exact isomorphism of C5 normalizers after filling the original two C5-fixed poles, followed by injective decorated C2 descent. Forgetting either branch point instead kills the explicitly based source meridians at zero and infinity, each generating a full closed Zhat. Both ordinary-point forgetting composites in the residual equalizer are given explicitly, share one exact four-point coordinate, and have an exact remaining cocycle defect in the intersection of two point-pushing kernels, identified as the closed normal closure of one peripheral meridian in Fhat6.
depends_on: F7.4-5 prime-order completed normalizers and full topology; F11 exact C5/D10 source and labels; F12 exact common-involution quotient and based R action; the specified covering and filling diagrams; the direct completed Birman kernel proof here
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part F(b), residual nonsolvable centralizer and exact quotient comparisons.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Original punctures, branch decorations, covering monodromy, both distinct forgetting composites, and their actual basepoints are retained.
notes: The C5 covering subgroup is unchanged after its two fixed poles become unmarked ramification points, so the two normalizer sequences have identical finite kernel and decorated quotient. Full induced topology makes the completed filling injection the actual ambient map. Forgetting the ordinary quotient point is not R-invariant; the two seven-point composites are kept separately. The exact residual group is the zero set of the displayed cocycle inside their equalizer. Triviality of either equalizer is not proved. The homology ranks are recorded only as checks, and F13 still excludes retractions of these exact composites.
computational_checks: code/part_a/common_reflection_forgetting_f14.py verifies the normalized coordinates, common coordinate, endpoint extensions, exact basepoint and whisker avoidance, and fourteen-by-twenty target winding maps.
